overview.description: The Inspire Capital Appreciation ETF (RISN) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Target Risk Moderate index. The fund is an actively-managed fund that tactically shift exposure between US equities and treasurys, or other defensive assets, that are screened for biblically-aligned criteria as defined by the Issuer. RISN was launched on Jul 15, 2020 and is issued by Inspire.
